newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Four miners dead in Australia coal mine flood.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Four miners dead in Australia coal mine flood.

text.p: Four miners are confirmed dead in the flooding of Gretley colliery in the Hunter Valley of New South Wales near Newcastle, Newcastle police said on Thursday.
Names could not be released until relatives were informed, a Kim Campbell of Newcastle police told Reuters.
The accident occurred at about 5.30 a.m. (1830 GMT) when miners broke through into old works which caused flooding, Bill Reid of Newcastle police also told Reuters.
Four other miners were also hit by floodwaters but survived, Reid said.
Rescue workers had been searching for the four miners 120 metres underground.
